role: These analyses are computed ONLY after the primary WP-1b result is frozen and tagged (Phase D). They are preregistered exploratory analyses only. They must NOT influence the primary WP-1b verdict, the calibration gate, sample membership, or any scientific knob.

metrics: macro per-task F1 difference with CI

X2_recall_vs_decision_split.description: agent recall on gold files INSIDE the RM-CSS candidate pool vs OUTSIDE it

X3_band_teacher_ceiling.description: reproduce RM-CSS probabilities p from the deployment artifact (coefficient order: continuous_features + boolean_features; see A3). Hybrid = RM-CSS decisions outside the band + agent decisions inside the band, for bands [0.10, 0.35) and [0.05, 0.35). Report hybrid F1 - RM-CSS F1 with paired bootstrap CI, and agent sensitivity / specificity on band files.
X3_band_teacher_ceiling.preregistered_reading: DISTILLATION_HEADROOM_PRESENT if, on band [0.10, 0.35), Q5 of (hybrid - RM-CSS) > 0 and the point estimate >= +0.03; otherwise NO_TEACHER_HEADROOM. This is a go / no-go signal for a future thesis pillar only.

X4_discovery_commitment_gap.description: share of gold files the agent read but did not select; share surfaced but not selected

X5_complementarity.description: pooled F1 of RM-CSS union Agent and RM-CSS intersection Agent

never_primary: X1-X5 never influence the primary WP-1b verdict, calibration gate, sample membership, or scientific knobs. Computed only after the primary result is frozen and tagged.
